label: HIV prevalence among adults (15-49)
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = UNAIDS' own epidemic indicators (the Global AIDS Update's modeled estimates, the Spectrum/EPP framework's central estimates), prevalence among adults 15-49 in percent, 161 entities, 1990-2024, reached through OWID's chart door (the direct UNAIDS machine door is closed from this environment — the probe record). A modeled-estimates canonical by necessity: no collector prints a prevalence (seroprevalence surveys feed the model, never the wire). No witness tier — the GHO and WB doors redistribute the same root (refused as auto-witnesses), and the IHME cross-root family is 403-blocked (re-confirmed live). The top_income_share constitution: the compilation the corpus names, displayed as what it is.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): OWID chart door = CC-BY-4.0 (OWID's chart-door terms; content: UNAIDS, Global AIDS Update — UNAIDS' own reuse terms apply upstream).
notes: THE TODD ARC PRINTS ITSELF (todd_refs: 1 citation, Où en sommes-nous ?): the book's Africa face rides the door richly — ESWATINI 1.2 (1990) -> 23.4 (2024) with the high-20s plateau, BOTSWANA 7.7 -> 15.7, SOUTH AFRICA 1.5 -> 17.2, ZAMBIA 9.4 -> 9.4 (the flat arc), ZIMBABWE peaking at 29.6 (1995) then falling — the patrilineal-belt geography the book maps, printed as the epidemic's own curves. FRANCE 0.13 (1990) -> 0.28 (2023) prints the low-prevalence European face. THE HONEST LIMITS: the compilation's own universe excludes the USA, Russia and China (verified identically on the GHO redistribution — the reporting shape itself; the regional aggregate that carries them drops logged); the corpus's own face is the WOMEN 15-49 slice (the by-sex estimates live behind the closed aidsinfo door — registered as the future door); the central estimates ride alone without their uncertainty intervals (dropped at parse with every OWID door — the standing record); the pre-1990 history and the count faces are territory curated/registered (the WB count door documented above).
